text: Pamela Julie Case, a software developer in the Research and Engineering department, had a flagged week. The UEBA system detected two anomalies that triggered rules: an elevated number of files copied to removable media and browsing to job-search or leak-publication sites atypical for her role. Specifically, she copied 15 files to removable media, which is far above her usual range, and visited job-search sites 12 times, significantly more than her typical 0 visits and above the peer range of 1 visit among 85 peers in her role.
